title: VOL (Volantio) ? INVOL (SELFREACC) � Promise = Last VOL Before SELFREACC
goal: Customer's flight was voluntarily changed via Volantio (VOL), then AC cancelled and customer self-rebooked via SELFREACC (INVOL). Validates that promise = last VOL arrival (12:00) before the SELFREACC, since SELFREACC = INVOL and does NOT update promise.

checkpoints.step: Customer's flight was voluntarily changed via Volantio (VOL), then AC cancelled and customer self-rebooked via SELFREACC (INVOL). Validates that promise = last VOL arrival (12:00) before the SELFREACC, since SELFREACC = INVOL and does NOT update promise.

checkpoints.step: And DDS checks booking change history:
checkpoints.expected: ? Change 1 (D-6): Volantio tool (identifier: SK VOLY) ? Classification: VOL (Volantio is always voluntary) ? Volantio changed arrival from 10:00 ? 12:00 ? Promise update: 10:00 ? 12:00 (VOL updates promise) ? Change 2 (D-1): INVOL � AC cancels the Volantio-rebooked flight ? Change 3 (D-1): SELFREACC � customer self-rebooks via tool (identifier: XXXAC08SR + UN/TK) ? Classification: INVOL (SELFREACC is INVOL � rebooking necessitated by airline cancellation) ? SELFREACC changed arrival from 12:00 ? 16:00 ? Promise update: NO � INVOL does NOT update promise ? Promise remains at: 12:00 (last VOL before first INVOL) ? Promise logic: Volantio VOL at D-6 updated promise to 12:00. INVOL cancel + SELFREACC at D-1 are both INVOL and do NOT further update promise. Promise = 12:00 (last VOL arrival before first INVOL) ? Actual arrival: 16:00 ? Delay from promise: 16:00 - 12:00 = 4 hours ? APPR: Delay 3�6h, Controllable (Code 42) ? ELIGIBLE � $400 CAD (Tier 1) ? CRITICAL ASSERTION: SELFREACC is INVOL � it must NOT update the promise even though the customer initiated the rebooking action. The rebooking was forced by airline cancellation.
